theme_strategy.rationale: High-visibility tactical look suitable for outdoor Indian transport fleets and intense data management, paired with Indian logistics vibrancy (orange/yellow). Avoids standard SaaS blues.

numbers.usage: KPIs, P&L amounts, Invoice numbers, FASTag balances

sidebar_nav.layout: Always visible on desktop, mobile behind hamburger menu

cards.style: Tactical Minimalism. Flat surface bg-card, 1px solid border-border, no soft shadows in dark mode.

kpi_tiles.layout: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density). col-span-1 for summary, col-span-2 for charts.
kpi_tiles.typography: JetBrains Mono for the main metric, Cabinet Grotesk for the title.

empty_states_upsell.alignment: Center-aligned (exception to the rule for focus)
empty_states_upsell.visual: Subtle ASCII or line-art illustration, NO AI emojis
empty_states_upsell.cta: Pill-shaped button or sharp button in secondary color (yellow) for high contrast. Text: 'Upgrade to [Plan]'

charts_recharts.tooltip: bg-card border border-border text-foreground rounded-md p-3 shadow-lg
charts_recharts.font: IBM Plex Sans for axes, JetBrains Mono for values

hero.layout: Left-aligned content, max-w-2xl. High-contrast background image with overlay.
hero.overlay: bg-black/60 to ensure text readability. NEVER fully transparent.

features.grid: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A). col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2 for Hero feature, col-span-4 for supporting features.

pricing.highlight: The 'Tracing Beam' effect for Pro plan card.

dashboard.hierarchy: Top row: KPIs. Middle row: AI Insights & Revenue charts. Bottom: Actionable tables (Expiring compliance, Low FASTag).

motion.hover_states: Required on all interactive elements. Buttons, cards, table rows.
motion.transitions: Specific properties only (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform 0.2s ease). NEVER use transition-all.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and list items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute

hero_background.description: Trucking on highway at sunset. Perfect for hero background.

feature_fleet.description: Parked trucks fleet. Good for Fleet management feature section.

feature_logistics.description: White semi truck driving down rural road. Good for trip tracking.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Text must flow naturally.
Cards and sections must not use generic soft shadows in dark mode. Rely on 1px borders for definition.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
Empty states must have a clear visual hierarchy ending in a primary color upsell button.
Ensure the sidebar is always visible on desktop and use standard navigation structures.
Only use Javascript (.js/.jsx) for components as no typescript setup is there.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Ensure focus states are clear and use high contrast. Do not use AI emoji characters for icons. Provide rich micro-interactions on hover and click. Do not use completely transparent backgrounds where text is overlayed. Always use text left alignment except for specific centered marketing elements.
